name: All Six Starters + EXP Options
description: Collect all six Kanto and Johto starters from Elm once each, with the shrinking menu from v1.2. In the game's START → OPTION menu, choose EXP GAIN from 1x to 10x with Left/Right. Default 1x; saved with normal game options. Multiplies battle EXP after trainer/traded/Lucky Egg bonuses, including EXP SHARE awards. Gameplay speed is independent.
notes: Back up your normal cartridge save before upgrading from v1.1/v1.2. Existing save layout and flags are preserved; old options default to 1x. Use CONTINUE rather than a numbered state from another patch. Stat EXP and the level-100 cap are unchanged. v1.0 upgrades and complete playthrough remain unverified.
